display.title: Episode 130: The Ten Wedding Gifts, Chapter 2
display.summary_short: Reuven pays for the orphans' wedding after they spent their money freeing a captive, and a mysterious rabbi arrives with ten students bearing astonishing gifts.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi starts this show with the Hakochainik march, because Hashem is found where there is simcha, followed by a sponsor message. Story time continues 'The Ten Wedding Gifts'. Avraham and Sarah had given away the 600 gold pieces Reuven gave them for wedding clothes to free an old man held captive by a cruel officer. Two young brothers lead the Shema in Studio 604, one of them celebrating his fourth birthday. Then Reuven tells the couple they did the great mitzvah of pidyon shvuyim, worth more than all the gold in the world, and pays for their clothes anyway. He invites the whole town to the wedding. Just before the chuppah, a holy-looking rabbi with a red beard and ten students walks in and is asked to say the brachos. At the meal he reveals that he is the Baal Shem Tov, sent by the Heavenly Court to bless them. Each student announces a gift, a park, a lumberyard and more, each belonging to a poritz. The Baal Shem Tov leaves in a driverless wagon that vanishes into the forest. To be continued. The show ends with a summer event announcement.
display.lesson: Hashem sees every good deed; freeing a captive and helping a bride and groom bring blessings beyond all the gold in the world.
